purpose: Curation strategy for the two static calendars: Family Calendar and Gig Radar.

travelTiers.label: Doorstep
travelTiers.threshold: Low. Include most public, dated family/music/theatre/community events unless explicitly disliked.

travelTiers.label: Easy local
travelTiers.threshold: Low-to-medium. Include family-friendly, music, theatre, heritage, outdoor, market/festival, railway, and culturally distinctive rows.

travelTiers.label: Easy train
travelTiers.threshold: Medium. Include if it clearly fits: toddler/family day out, free daytime culture/music, theatre, folk/trad, or high-quality destination programming.

travelTiers.label: Destination
travelTiers.threshold: High. Include only if it is unusually good, date-specific, family-relevant, strongly in-genre, or worth planning around.

primaryModes.label: Daytime music
exclude: generic open mic unless very local
late pub gigs unless The Lamb or strongly relevant

alwaysCheckSources.name: Royal Borough of Kingston events
alwaysCheckSources.why: Broad borough feed; useful for family festivals, markets, heritage, council-run outdoor events; must filter out wellbeing/business/repair/admin noise.

alwaysCheckSources.name: Surbiton Partnership What's On
alwaysCheckSources.why: Best broad Surbiton feed; low inclusion threshold for local family/music/theatre but needs strict filtering for fitness, quizzes and generic wellbeing.

alwaysCheckSources.name: Rose Theatre Kingston
alwaysCheckSources.why: High-value nearby theatre plus free cafe music; selected-date music rows should be split into individual dates rather than date ranges.

alwaysCheckSources.name: Hampton Court Palace
alwaysCheckSources.why: Member-relevant family destination. Include palace/garden/festival/seasonal family events with a lower threshold than other outer-edge destinations.

alwaysCheckSources.name: Thames Ditton Miniature Railway
alwaysCheckSources.why: One-of-a-kind nearby family attraction; include public running days/open days even when recurring.

alwaysCheckSources.name: Canbury Bandstand
alwaysCheckSources.why: Ideal Sunday daytime music. Include dated concerts and keep an eye on social updates when the site lags.

alwaysCheckSources.name: Polka Theatre
alwaysCheckSources.why: Wimbledon is easy enough and Polka is high-quality toddler/children's theatre; include age-appropriate shows and workshops.

alwaysCheckSources.name: Southbank Centre family/free events
alwaysCheckSources.why: Waterloo is easy by train; include free/daytime/family music, workshops and genuinely good family culture, not the whole programme.

alwaysCheckSources.name: National Theatre
alwaysCheckSources.why: Easy from Waterloo; include family-relevant theatre or especially strong date-night theatre only.

alwaysCheckSources.name: National Trust - Morden Hall Park
alwaysCheckSources.why: Wimbledon/Morden edge family day-out source; include child-friendly trails, seasonal family days and outdoor events.

primaryModes.label: Nearby / easy
primaryModes.threshold: Lower bar if live music is close and plausibly in the user's taste.

primaryModes.label: Strict genre
primaryModes.threshold: Genre match matters more than location.

primaryModes.label: Date night
include: bookable music worth arranging childcare for
primaryModes.threshold: Closer venues can be casual; central/further venues need stronger genre or quality.

primaryModes.label: Worth the trip
primaryModes.threshold: High. Use for far or more awkward travel only.

alwaysCheckSources.name: The Lamb Surbiton Instagram/social
alwaysCheckSources.why: The site often lags social posts; screenshots/OCR should be checked for dated music.

alwaysCheckSources.name: Ram Jam Records
alwaysCheckSources.why: Local Kingston live music with a readable events feed; include only in-genre or strong date-night rows.

alwaysCheckSources.name: The Jazz Guide
alwaysCheckSources.why: Useful for trad/hot/swing-adjacent jazz listings, but must filter out modern jazz and check venue detail where possible.

alwaysCheckSources.name: SwingdanceUK special events
alwaysCheckSources.why: Live-band swing and social dance events in London; good genre fit.

alwaysCheckSources.name: Swing Out London
alwaysCheckSources.why: London swing dance socials/classes and live vintage jazz opportunities.

alwaysCheckSources.name: Irish Cultural Centre Hammersmith
alwaysCheckSources.why: Public traditional Irish sessions; family-friendly wording makes some sessions relevant even if not local.

alwaysCheckSources.name: Irish Music in London session listing
alwaysCheckSources.why: Maintained trad session list; use for discovery and then verify venue/date details.

alwaysCheckSources.name: Halibuts swing listings
alwaysCheckSources.why: Broad London swing feed; useful but noisy, especially musicals and crooner residencies.

feedbackPolicy.rule: Treat rejected rows and notes as strong negative examples. Avoid exact repeats and close matches by title, venue, category, genre and reason unless a future event is clearly different or much higher value.
feedbackPolicy.staticSiteLimit: The web page can store feedback in browser localStorage and export JSON. A scheduled local updater can only read the exported file if it exists in updater/user-feedback.json.
